capabilities: copy a cursor-line reference like path/to/file.md:25
copy a single-line selection with line and column positions
copy a multi-line selection with start and end line-column ranges
choose between relative vault paths and absolute local paths
run from the command palette or a custom plugin shortcut
extras: Works entirely locally with no network requests or analytics; falls back to relative paths when absolute paths are unavailable. The README also documents a GitHub Actions release workflow aimed at developers.
motivation: The author built it to interact with AI agents more precisely, giving them a concrete location to inspect or discuss instead of a vague description.
problem: Pointing an AI agent at a specific spot in a note means vaguely describing its position, since Obsidian offers no built-in way to copy precise line and column references.
summary: Line-reference copier that copies file:line:column references from the cursor or selection for pasting into AI agent conversations.
